known_limitations: Winner prediction remains independent binary, not a normalized race distribution.
2025 remains frozen holdout and unserved by replay and prediction.
Global permutation evidence is PRE_2025_FINAL_FIT_IN_SAMPLE, not temporally out-of-sample.
Explanations are associational and model-internal, not causal.
Feature contributions are additive in log-odds, not probability points.
SHAP is not part of v1.
Replay timeline operates at prediction checkpoints, not every replay frame.
No live F1 feed; static Models/About evidence is a frozen project snapshot.
No cross-family model latency benchmark exists; inference throughput only.
scientific_boundaries: No retraining, refitting, retuning, recalibration, or 2025 reevaluation.
No Phase-1 through Phase-8 scientific code modified.
No new metrics, model rankings, or normalized winner shares.
Generator consumes only the frozen 2025 holdout report for holdout evidence.
Explanations stay associational and model-internal, never causal.
